DAY BY DAY

The weekend rhythm.
Every Friday night.

Next window: upcoming weekend. Order may flex for weather, traffic and parking — Sunday 9:00 PM return stays fixed.

  1. Day 0 Friday · Delhi NCR departure

    Report, luggage loading, short introductions, then depart at 10:00 PM.

    • Overnight road journey towards Manali with planned meal and driver-rest breaks
    • Coordinator number and vehicle details shared before departure
  2. Day 1 Saturday · Arrive & Manali town

    Expected arrival 12:00–3:00 PM (traffic and weather dependent).

    • Tent / hotel check-in, lunch and rest
    • Monastery / Gompa · Mall Road & Tibetan Market
    • Beas Riverside if daylight allows · evening bonfire at camp · overnight stay
  3. Day 2 Sunday · Main sightseeing day

    Core circuit — flexible for weather. Drop Vashisht first if the day runs late.

    • Nehru Kund → Kothi → Solang Valley
    • Hadimba · Old Manali · Vashisht if time
    • Dinner, luggage — depart Manali at 9:00 PM
  4. Day 3 Monday · Delhi return

    Overnight return. Expected Delhi NCR arrival 10:00 AM–1:00 PM — not guaranteed.

    • Driver-rest and meal breaks on the road
    • Drop points confirmed with the host for your weekend

PLACES WE PRIORITIZE

Must-visits & smart alternatives.

Primary plan: Manali town + Solang. Atal Tunnel–Sissu or Naggar are alternatives — not forced into the same day.

Must visit

Solang Valley

~13 km from Manali. Open Himalayan valley and scenic photography.

Must visit

Hadimba Devi Temple

Wooden pagoda temple in cedar forest — Ghatotkacha shrine nearby.

Must visit

Old Manali

Village lanes, wooden houses, riverside cafes and Manu Temple.

Core town

Mall Road & Gompa

Markets, woollens, cafes and the Nyingmapa monastery stop.

If time

Vashisht

Temple village and Beas Valley views — first stop to drop if delayed.

Optional · paid

Adventure park

Ropes and activity parks nearby — not included. Join only if you want.

Optional

Atal Tunnel · Sissu

Full-day Lahaul scenery only when weather and roads allow.

Alternative

Naggar heritage

Castle and valley views as a heritage half-day swap.

Scenic

Waterfall stop

Hill waterfall viewpoints when the day’s pacing allows.

En route

Nehru Kund · Kothi

Short scenic stops on the way towards Solang.

GOOD TO KNOW

Practical notes for every weekend.

Pack warm. Layers, waterproof outerwear and shoes with grip — hills change quickly.

Stay access matters. Saturday early check-in and Sunday late checkout / day-use until ~7–8 PM are part of the plan.

Flexible Sunday. Sightseeing order can change for traffic, parking, weather and road controls.

Safety first. Higher roads only when local conditions and the driver confirm it is safe.
